scope: ADDITIVE to spec/screens.json — the Settings editor screen.

screen.label: League settings

layout.banner: between top bar and body, full width, persists across navigation

decision.name: shadow recompute with atomic user-triggered swap
decision.summary: job runs in background, app stays fully usable, nothing changes on screen, new values land only on explicit Apply

rejected.why: 60s reads as a hang; removes the reason the user is here; makes failure cost the whole wait
a scoring change invalidates nearly every number, so the whole app hatches out — a slower freeze that teaches users to ignore the stale treatment

decision.keyReframe: pre-edit numbers are not stale, they are correct — the change is not applied, so the old scoring is still in force
consequences: principle #3 satisfied by construction, not vigilance
failure is trivially safe — nothing to unwind
no ambush: values never rearrange under a user mid-scan

states.app: fully usable, all fresh, steppers inert

states.banner: NEW VALUES READY + Apply / Keep old

screen.gridConstraint: Every track set must fit the fluid left pane at a 924px viewport (pane = 502px). No track may use minmax(0,…) — a zero floor lets the FIELD column collapse to invisible, which breaks the trace-affordance constraint. Assert scrollWidth === clientWidth on all three grids.
screen.fieldAffordance: Displayed field text may drop a prefix shared by the whole column when the column header names it (FIELD · league.scoring.*), but the full dotted path must always be present in a title attribute. Never let a field name truncate without a hover fallback.

contractRequirements: apply is a separate call from job completion — the server holds the result and must not mutate league.settings before it
a held result is superseded if pending settings change; return superseded:true rather than applying a stale computation
availability_stale is returned by both endpoints; tier-1 changes set it too
job ownership is the league, not the session — other tabs and devices see the same state

checks.assert: During a tier-2 recompute, no number anywhere in the app differs from its pre-edit value
checks.probe: snapshot all numeric cells before edit and at 50% progress

checks.assert: The app is navigable during a recompute — nothing is disabled behind a modal
checks.probe: start job, navigate to Board and Draft

checks.assert: Job completion does not change any displayed value; only Apply does
checks.probe: let job finish, snapshot, press Apply, snapshot
checks.expect: unchanged at completion; changed after Apply

checks.assert: An edited scoring rule shows both the in-force and edited values
Progress shows a named stage and a percent, with all five stages listed
checks.probe: read the status rail during a job
checks.expect: stage name, pct, 5 stage rows with done/active/pending glyphs

checks.assert: A failed job leaves league.settings unchanged and retains the edit
checks.probe: trigger failure, inspect settings and the diff panel

checks.assert: Stale values carry hatch + dagger + reduced contrast + a section tag
checks.probe: apply a change, inspect an availability cell

checks.assert: Stale and null are visually distinguishable in greyscale
checks.expect: hatch/dagger vs em dash still distinct

checks.assert: A tier-1 change applies instantly with no job and still marks availability stale
checks.probe: increment bench, observe VBD and availability

checks.assert: Scoring steppers do not respond while a job is in flight
checks.expect: no change; reason visible in the banner

checks.assert: --fail is not the same colour as --live
The recompute banner persists across navigation
All three settings grids fit their pane at a 924px viewport — no clipped columns
checks.expect: true for scoring rules, roster slots, board preview

checks.assert: Every FIELD cell renders its text untruncated, and carries the full dotted path in a title attribute
checks.probe: for each field cell: scrollWidth <= clientWidth AND getAttribute('title') is the full path
checks.expect: no truncation; title present on every cell
checks.note: a pixel floor is not sufficient — a 100px track passes a >=84px check while still clipping league.scoring.rush_rec_td

founderDecisions.question: Are scoring edits blocked during a live draft?
founderDecisions.why: changing scoring mid-draft rebases every recommendation the user has already acted on

founderDecisions.question: If the user closes the tab mid-job, does the result auto-apply on next open?
If the user edits again mid-job, cancel and restart automatically or ask?
founderDecisions.why: a held result nobody wants is clutter

founderDecisions.question: Who can edit — commissioner only, or anyone with the league open?
founderDecisions.why: determines whether the banner needs an actor name
